name: XBITVault fail-open transfer authorization while unbound
summary: XBITVault keeps the XBIT balance ledger, and its transfer(from,to,amount) only checks msg.sender == xbitContract when xbitContract is set; bindXBIT was never called, so anyone could move anyone's XBIT. The attacker moved the XBIT/USDT pair's XBIT to itself, synced the pair and sold back for its USDT. A copycat repeated it against an unbound sibling vault.
notes: The vault is immutable and xbitContract stayed zero from construction until the owner's bindXBIT after the exploit, so the deployment is the reset.

Campaign: the attacker's second contract run and a copycat that drained this pair's remainder and the pair of sibling vault 0x7612bede (same deployer and template, never bound); pair Sync scans on all four sibling pairs find no earlier exploit. Loss is the USDT both pairs lost, at DefiLlama prices.
